purpose: Run evidence-based Storyworld Studio UX audits and provide separately authorized implementation guidance without confusing model suggestions, human decisions, canon, releases, or publication authority.

local_changes: Adapted only transferable audit workflow concepts from the local Commerce Foundry UX skill architecture.
Replaced merchant and commerce framing with Storyworld creator, canon, continuity, review, release, and publishing authority semantics.
Collapsed transferred audit concepts into a progressively loaded core with bounded Storyworld references.
Aligned design guidance with current vendored Studio primitives, Tailwind v4 tokens, accepted V1 alpha evidence, and repository authority.

Added an operator-approved conditional protected first-use pass that defers intended-path context, records expectation-versus-result evidence, and preserves raw notes during later expert verification.

Added an operator-approved canon-and-consequences protocol covering lifecycle-state legibility, rationale and creative provenance, affected work, contradiction visibility, and exact pre-approval effects.

Added an operator-approved routed mockup-comparison mode that bounds design intent against current implementation and product authority, separates visual, behavioral, and independent concerns, and preserves unknown states.
Added an operator-approved mockup feature-gap mode that classifies implied capabilities and produces evidence-bounded, non-authorizing proposals for genuinely new Storyworld product capabilities.

Added an operator-approved, conditionally loaded complex-workspace protocol covering layered navigation, graph/canvas access and orientation, multi-author conflicts and attribution, and dense-interface comprehension without hiding authority.

limitations: The protected unprimed first-use protocol has not been exercised; REV-0001 correctly declined it because the evaluator was already primed.

The canon-consequences, mockup-comparison, mockup-feature-gap, accessibility, complex-workspace, and visual-QA protocols were exercised in the primed expert audit REV-0001, not as participant evidence.
The complex-workspace protocol has not been exercised against an implemented rendered graph/canvas or live multi-author Studio workflow.
Current alpha behavior and design sources must be reinspected on every use.
Browser, assistive-technology, and participant coverage depends on separately available and authorized evidence.
